findings.title: Clicking 'Build the final with TRELLIS.2' a second time with the same link does nothing
findings.detail: UrlModel only acts when the values in the URL change: the ?image= effect depends on [image, onImage] and the ?model= effect on [id, mode, ...]. The button sits on the same /image-to-3d page. Say the user clicks it on result A, then changes the photo or the mode by hand, then clicks the same card again. The URL is the same, so neither effect runs and the form keeps what the user changed, so the click looks like it did nothing. Clicking a different Idol card works, because its image changes. ?model= links already behaved this way before this package, so this is not a regression of existing behaviour, but it is the main repeat flow of this new button. Found by reading the code; not reproduced in a browser.
findings.verified: Traced: fromImage and fromUrl are stable useCallbacks, and the effects' deps are strings taken from useSearchParams.

findings.title: ?image= turns Idol's photo crop off on the wrong premise
findings.detail: fromImage calls setIdolPhoto(false), with the comment 'a Fuobe result's, so Idol's photo crop stays off'. But model3dView(g).photo is request.inputs.images[0], the Idol run's source picture. That is normally the user's own upload: the e2e script uses /api/uploads, and idolPhotoFor counts uploads as photos. This has no effect on the TRELLIS.2 final, since the crop only applies in Splat mode. It is wrong if the user then switches to Splat with Idol, or if idol-5 reuses ?image= as the report suggests (?mode=splat&model=oss-idol&image=...): an uploaded photo would get the synthetic crop. A better choice is to leave the switch as it is, or to set it with idolPhotoFor.
findings.verified: Read model3dView (photo: g.request.inputs?.images?.[0]) and idolPhotoFor in src/lib/av/model3d.ts.

findings.title: The card and studio wiring is tested only by matching source text
findings.detail: The access, visitor and Paid-APIs-only gating in the studio is checked by an exact source-text match of the finalAllowed line. The pure finalBuildHref and offered() are unit-tested properly, and the browser script covers the visible flow in demo mode. A refactor that keeps behaviour would break the string test, and a behaviour change that keeps the text would pass it. The engineMode 'cloud' case and the visitor case have no behavioural test. This is acceptable for a P2 small package.

findings.title: ?image= is taken as given (no /api/files check)
findings.detail: Any value of ?image= becomes the photo's ref and preview. Main's studio-page and color-grade already do the same; only live-edit-app checks with fileParam (/api/files/ only). Only the owner can run 3D: visitors are blocked in the UI, and the server answers own-gpu-tool for accounts. An does not run javascript: URLs. So this is not exploitable here and is not a new class of problem. Checking with a fileParam-style pattern would be tidier.
